name: Belief Perseverance (The Backfire Effect)
definition: A belief persists after its supporting evidence is discredited; strengthening after correction is a distinct backfire pattern.
boundary: Preserved source umbrella: record perseverance and backfire as separate subtypes; persistence does not imply strengthening.
